rationale: The work is bounded to a repository-local standard-library preview package that reads only committed governed records, emits one canonical preview, and never writes a target or grants application authority.
affected_boundaries: new exact preview schema and committed fixture
focused tests and FREEZER CI path filters
existing_assumptions: Human Review Ledger verification is the source of current review state.
An empty, stale, expired, rejected, returned, conflicted, or otherwise non-current review state must block application readiness.
The proposal, regression result, rollback snapshot, policy, reviewer scope, and target snapshot remain committed and fingerprintable.
Repository-local preview generation is sufficient for the v1 non-applying claim.

data_migration.notes: The implementation adds a new immutable preview fixture and does not rewrite existing proposal, review, outcome, regression, rollback, or loop records.

external_interfaces: CLI commands limited to generate, verify, and summary
approval_changes: No human decision is created or modified.
The preview consumes verified review state but does not turn it into application, merge, mutation, publication, or external-action authority.
The current empty Human Review Ledger must produce a blocked preview.
regression_tests: blocked output when no approval exists
stale or mismatched source fingerprint rejection
widened application or mutation authority rejection
governed-loop component linkage and non-authority checks
hidden_dependencies: skill regression result and rollback snapshot
governed target snapshot path and fingerprint
rollback_boundary: Delete the new promotion_application_preview package and revert the governed-loop preview component integration; no target or adjacent repository has been written.
completion_conditions: The preview package generates one deterministic canonical record from exact committed inputs.
The current empty ledger produces BLOCKED / NOT_APPROVED / NOT_APPLIED with explicit blockers.
Every proposed target path, expected fingerprint, validation step, stop condition, and rollback reference is explicit and fail-closed.
The governed one-shot loop verifies the preview component without widening authority.
All focused and full repository tests pass on the final PR head.
The item reaches VERIFIED and COMPLETED only after implementation is merged and reverified on main.
risks: Preview semantics may accidentally imply that approval alone authorizes application.
Target-snapshot drift may make a previously generated preview unsafe.
A future executor may ignore blockers or stop conditions.
Generated preview data may expose private content unless limited to paths, identifiers, hashes, and bounded summaries.
